summaryFa: صورتی از برج کج سبز ایراد می‌گیرد، اما برج خودش پایهٔ ضعیف‌تری دارد؛ بعد از افتادنش، همان قطعات را با پایهٔ پهن‌تر می‌چیند.
storyFa: بالا سمت راست، صورتی به برج کج سبز اشاره می‌کند و می‌گوید «این چرا کجه؟»، در حالی که برج خودش کنار او روی پایه‌ای باریک و ناپایدار ایستاده است. بالا سمت چپ، برج خودش افتاده؛ صورتی قطعات را بررسی می‌کند و سه قطعه را برای پایه‌ای پهن کنار هم می‌گذارد. پایین، برج خودش با پایهٔ پهن و چیدمان پایدار دوباره ساخته شده و صورتی از نتیجه خوشحال است.
meaningFa: توجه به ایراد دیگران آسان است؛ وقتی صورتی ضعفِ پایهٔ برج خودش را می‌بیند و اصلاح می‌کند، کار خودش نتیجهٔ بهتری می‌گیرد.

Use case: illustration-story.
Create ONE NEW SQUARE 1:1 book illustration with THREE softly separated scenes: TOP RIGHT first, TOP LEFT second, ONE WIDE LOWER scene third. Persian reading order right-to-left then down. Slim clean white paper gaps; no heavy comic frames.

Input image is ONLY a STYLE reference: match its moderate authentic hand-painted layered translucent watercolor, simple neutral adult figures, perfectly circular heads, modest dark oval eyes with tiny interior glints, local colored contour lines and irregular painted edges with white paper outside. DO NOT copy its tailor, apron, sewing machine, room, objects or writing.

Story «پایهٔ برج خودم»: It is easy to spot somebody else's flaw; spotting and repairing your own brings a better result. Make it concrete, immediately readable, with kind human wit.
Sparse sunny indoor creative corner, simple wooden building blocks on floor, no other tools.
TOP RIGHT: Two ordinary ADULT figures PINK and GREEN are constructing wooden-block towers. PINK stands next to HER OWN tower, which has an obviously inadequate very NARROW base: one little bottom block supporting too many wider blocks above, visibly unstable. PINK is ignoring that and pointing at GREEN's separate slightly leaning tower with a gently smug expression; a SMALL thought bubble belonging clearly to PINK reads exactly «این چرا کجه؟». GREEN looks calmly at their own tower. The weak base of PINK's own tower is a major clear visible element, not hidden behind PINK. Distinguish ownership by placing each tower directly beside its builder and keeping these locations consistent.
TOP LEFT: PINK's OWN unstable tower has now fallen harmlessly into a small heap of its SAME wooden blocks on the floor; NOTHING strikes anyone. PINK crouches next to the heap, surprised and thoughtful, examining the little single-block base. She is already arranging THREE of the SAME blocks side by side on the floor to form a much BROADER stable base. Keep her neutral adult proportions. GREEN and the other tower may be omitted in this closer scene so the repair action is clear. No bubble or additional writing here.
LOWER WIDE: PINK has rebuilt HER OWN tower from the SAME recognizable wooden blocks. It stands tall and STRAIGHT on a clearly BROAD three-block base, with progressively fewer blocks per tier above it, a physically sensible stable structure. PINK is pleased and lightly proud, hands relaxed, looking at HER OWN successful tower. GREEN stands nearby smiling warmly, their separate modest tower visible at the side; GREEN is not presenting a reward or fixing PINK's work. PINK's repaired foundation and visibly stable result are the main payoff. No award, trophy or lesson caption. Gentle self-recognition instead of mocking humiliation.

Character invariants: PINK and GREEN remain EXACTLY same colors and identities in every scene. Both have a balanced medium adult build, neither elongated thin nor chunky. Genders have SAME neutral body silhouette: no bust, no pinched waist, no prominent hips or buttocks, no bulges or indentations. PINK has only a few short delicate curved lashes at the upper outer corners of the SAME small dark oval eyes as GREEN, not a different eye design. Tiny white glints INSIDE dark eyes allowed; absolutely NO white sclera surrounding pupils, no doll eyes or heavy lash fans. Heads PERFECT CIRCLES, no jaw/chin, no oval, NO nose, ears or hair. NO neck: head joins upper shoulders directly with a gentle darker LOCAL-color crescent contact shadow. Both have plain colored bodies, NO apron or other clothes. Body and head contours use DARKER SHADES OF THEIR OWN COLOR, never black outlines. Every visible hand has exactly THREE fingers plus ONE thumb; natural block-grip occlusion is okay.

Medium: visibly authentic restrained watercolor INSIDE all heads, torsos, arms, hands, legs and feet as well as scene; broad softly uneven overlapping transparent washes, subtle pigment pooling, luminous paper. NOT uniform pencil/marker texture, flat vector fills, glossy 3D, heavy mottling or ink-black body contours.
Composition: full people, ALL feet, towers, bases and fallen blocks fully contained with generous WHITE outer margins; never crop bodies or props at canvas or scene bottom. Sparse setting, natural irregular paint endings, pigment never touches file edges. Correct connected RTL Persian, ONLY the one specified phrase. No English or watermark. Warm family-friendly story, readable without external explanation.
